request: Replace short blades with longswords and remove shields.

stages.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the supplied Egyptian game sprite sheet. Correct ONLY the weapon and shield for this same Egyptian soldier. Replace every short sword with a visibly LONG, straight two-handed longsword: blade from crossguard to tip approximately the full height of the standing character, more than twice the previous short blade length, with a slim steel blade, pointed tip, clear crossguard and longer leather grip. Remove EVERY round shield entirely in ALL 64 sprites, including back/side views; no shield on arm, back, ground or belt. Use both hands on the long grip for ready/attack poses. Keep the dark tan skin, gold-striped black cloth headdress, blue-grey tunic/kilt, sandals, original stocky character proportions, tiny pre-rendered Cultures RTS style and fixed isometric camera. Preserve EXACTLY EIGHT isolated rows with EXACTLY EIGHT complete sprites in each row (64 total), distinct eight facings in original column order S SW W NW N NE E SE. Rows stay idle, four walk phases, attack windup, contact, recovery. Do not delete or merge rows. Do not introduce short swords in any pose. All blades, heads and feet fully visible, generous genuinely transparent gaps between every cell and around outer image edges. No neighboring sprites touch, no clipping, no added text, no grid lines, no shadows, no scenery. Allow the long blade to point diagonally upward at rest to fit cleanly; turn the character, never shrink the blade. Transparent background, preserve the same identity across the sheet.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create a NEW production sprite sheet using the input ONLY as a character identity, costume and weapon reference. Do NOT preserve the input's faulty layout. Output one square image, EXACTLY 8 COLUMNS AND 8 ROWS, 64 tiny complete soldiers on real transparent alpha. Think of 64 equal square cells. CRITICAL: The BODY from head to feet occupies only 35% of cell height, LONG SWORD BLADE equals full standing body height, and the whole figure plus long sword occupies at most 65% of the cell in either direction. This intentionally leaves very large transparent gaps between ALL rows and columns and around outer edges. Shrink the whole character, never shorten the sword. No adjacent sprites touch, all sword tips have generous padding. NO SHIELDS anywhere. Two-handed long straight steel sword with crossguard and extended grip, blade clearly longer than a short sword. Preserve same character/costume/palette/isometric camera/pixel art style from reference. Each row has 8 facings, S SW W NW N NE E SE in order, genuinely back-facing middle columns. The EIGHT rows are: 1 standing ready; 2 walking left foot forward; 3 walking passing; 4 walking right foot forward; 5 walking opposite passing; 6 sword overhead windup; 7 sword strike contact; 8 recovering to ready stance. Include all EIGHT rows, including the FOUR different walking rows. Do not collapse or omit walking rows. Keep uniform character scale. Clean crisp alpha edges, remove stray red/yellow outline pixels. No text, labels, cell borders, scenery or ground shadows. A correctly spaced 8x8 sheet is more important than filling the canvas.

Precise sprite sheet correction. Keep this Egyptian soldier identity, LONG sword, NO shield, colors, eight columns and EXACT EIGHT rows. Preserve rows 1 through 6 and row 8. ONLY fix row SEVEN (the sword contact/strike row, second from bottom): sword tips currently run into neighboring sprites' horizontal regions. Repose all eight strike sprites with their long sword diagonally forward at around 45 degrees so EACH sprite's entire horizontal extent including sword is less than 105 pixels on this 1254px sheet (each cell approximately157px). Keep each individual strike sprite isolated with at least20 transparent columns of space on each side of it. Keep the same long blade length; adjust the arm pose/sword angle to reduce horizontal width instead of shortening the sword. Do not shift or remove any row or column. Do not attach or add shields. No stray colored edge pixels, no text or cell borders. Genuine transparent background. 8 rows x8 columns =64 separate complete sprites, no touching or clipping.
